title: Lifesteal
tagline: Steal hearts. Build your empire. Survive the lethal hunt.
features: Custom Heart Stealing mechanics on kill
Revive Beacon system to bring fallen teammates back
Hourly Airdrops & KOTH (King of the Hill) events
description: Every player starts with 10 hearts. Kill another player to steal 1 of their permanent hearts. Lose all your hearts and get eliminated into spectator mode until revived by your clan. Build impenetrable bases, forge deadly alliances, and rule the pack.

title: BoxPvP
tagline: Mine, upgrade, and dominate the fast-paced enclosed battlefield.
features: Tiered Mining Mines from Coal to Netherite & Beyond
Custom BoxPvP Weapons, Shurikens & Special Bows
description: A high-octane PvP environment inside customized battle boxes. Farm ores, trade with villagers for overpowered custom god gear, and step right into the combat pit. Fast respawns, instant action, and non-stop adrenaline.

title: Practice
tagline: Refine your combos. Master every kit. Climb the global Elo ranks.
features: Kit selection: Nodebuff, Crystal, Axe, Gapple, Boxing, Sumo
Match replay system & comprehensive PvP stats
description: The ultimate battleground to sharpen your combat instincts. Whether you are practicing crystal PvP, perfecting pot-PvP sprint combos, or practicing sword mechanics, WolfMC Practice provides zero-delay, tournament-grade arenas.
